body: A scalable generative AI framework built for researchers and developers working on Large Language Models, Multimodal, and Speech AI (Automatic Speech Recognition and Text-to-Speech)
plain_description: NVIDIA NeMo Speech lets you build, customize, and deploy speech AI models — ASR, TTS, and Speech LLMs — using pre-trained checkpoints and existing code. The big picture: researchers and developers can go from idea to production faster without reinventing the wheel. Here's why it matters: you get NVIDIA-optimized performance on GPU infrastructure with Docker or pip install.
technical_description: NVIDIA NeMo Speech is a PyTorch-based framework for building, fine-tuning, and deploying speech AI models including Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), Text-to-Speech (TTS), and Speech LLMs. It provides pre-trained model checkpoints, modular model collections (ASR, TTS, audio, speechlm2), and inference pipelines with streaming support. The framework installs via pip (nemo-toolkit[asr,tts]) or Docker, requires Python ≥3.12 and PyTorch ≥2.7, and depends on NVIDIA GPU + CUDA for training. It includes tools for dataset processing, forced alignment, speech data exploration, and voice agent construction using the Pipecat framework.
title: NVIDIA NeMo Speech
